entities.summary: Petar Poparsov or Petar Pop Arsov was a Macedonian Bulgarian revolutionary, teacher and one of the founders of the Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization (IMRO). He was also a founder of the Young Macedonian Literary Society.
